accessibilitySupport.title: Accessibility Support
accessibilitySupport.description: Controls if the UI should run in a mode where it is optimized for screen readers.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Use platform APIs to detect when a Screen Reader is attached

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Optimize for usage with a Screen Reader

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Assume a screen reader is not attached

accessibilityPageSize.title: Accessibility Page Size
accessibilityPageSize.description: Controls the number of lines in the editor that can be read out by a screen reader at once. When we detect a screen reader we automatically set the default to be 10. Warning: this has a performance implication for numbers larger than the default.

autoClosingBrackets.title: Auto Closing Brackets
autoClosingBrackets.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close brackets after the user adds an opening bracket.

oneOf.title: Language-defined
oneOf.description: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose brackets.

oneOf.title: Before Whitespace
oneOf.description: Autoclose brackets only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.

autoClosingComments.title: Auto Closing Comments
autoClosingComments.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close comments after the user adds an opening comment.

oneOf.title: Language-defined
oneOf.description: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose comments.

oneOf.title: Before Whitespace
oneOf.description: Autoclose comments only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.

autoClosingDelete.title: Auto Closing Delete
autoClosingDelete.description: Controls whether the editor should remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets when deleting.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.

autoClosingOvertype.title: Auto Closing Overtype
autoClosingOvertype.description: Controls whether the editor should type over closing quotes or brackets.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Type over closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted.

autoClosingQuotes.title: Auto Closing Quotes
autoClosingQuotes.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically close quotes after the user adds an opening quote.

oneOf.title: Language-defined
oneOf.description: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose quotes.

oneOf.title: Before Whitespace
oneOf.description: Autoclose quotes only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace.

autoIndent.title: Auto Indent
autoIndent.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically adjust the indentation when users type, paste, move or indent lines.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: The editor will not insert indentation automatically.

oneOf.title: Advanced
oneOf.description: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets and invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages.

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets, invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages, and honor indentationRules defined by languages.

oneOf.title: Brackets
oneOf.description: The editor will keep the current line's indentation and honor language defined brackets.

oneOf.title: Keep
oneOf.description: The editor will keep the current line's indentation.

autoSurround.title: Auto Surround
autoSurround.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically surround selections when typing quotes or brackets.

oneOf.title: Language-defined
oneOf.description: Use language configurations to determine when to automatically surround selections.

oneOf.title: Quotes
oneOf.description: Surround with quotes but not brackets.

oneOf.title: Brackets
oneOf.description: Surround with brackets but not quotes.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether bracket pair colorization is enabled or not. Use [[Workbench: Color Customizations]] to override the bracket highlight colors.

independentColorPoolPerBracketType.title: Independent Color Pool Per Bracket Type
independentColorPoolPerBracketType.description: Controls whether each bracket type has its own independent color pool.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Controls whether the editor shows Code Lens.

codeLensFontFamily.title: Code Lens Font Family
codeLensFontFamily.description: Controls the font family for Code Lens.

codeLensFontSize.title: Code Lens Font Size
codeLensFontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels for Code Lens. When set to 0, 90% of `#fontSize#` is used.

colorDecorators.title: Color Decorators
colorDecorators.description: Controls whether the editor should render the inline color decorators and color picker.

colorDecoratorsActivatedOn.title: Color Decorators Activated On
colorDecoratorsActivatedOn.description: Controls the condition to make a color picker appear from a color decorator.

oneOf.title: Click and Hover
oneOf.description: Make the color picker appear both on click and hover of the color decorator

oneOf.title: Click
oneOf.description: Make the color picker appear on click of the color decorator

oneOf.title: Hover
oneOf.description: Make the color picker appear on hover of the color decorator

colorDecoratorsLimit.title: Color Decorators Limit
colorDecoratorsLimit.description: Controls the max number of color decorators that can be rendered in an editor at once.

columnSelection.title: Column Selection
columnSelection.description: Enable that the selection with the mouse and keys is doing column selection.

ignoreEmptyLines.title: Ignore Empty Lines
ignoreEmptyLines.description: Controls if empty lines should be ignored with toggle, add or remove actions for line comments.

insertSpace.title: Insert Space
insertSpace.description: Controls whether a space character is inserted when commenting.

copyWithSyntaxHighlighting.title: Copy With Syntax Highlighting
copyWithSyntaxHighlighting.description: Controls whether syntax highlighting should be copied into the clipboard.

defaultColorDecorators.title: Default Color Decorators
defaultColorDecorators.description: Controls whether inline color decorations should be shown using the default document color provider.

definitionLinkOpensInPeek.title: Definition Link Opens In Peek
definitionLinkOpensInPeek.description: Controls whether the Go to Definition mouse gesture always opens the peek widget.

detectIndentation.title: Detect Indentation
detectIndentation.description: Controls whether `#tabSize#` and `#insertSpaces#` will be automatically detected when a file is opened based on the file contents.

dragAndDrop.title: Drag And Drop
dragAndDrop.description: Controls whether the editor should allow moving selections via drag and drop.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether you can drag and drop a file into a text editor by holding down the Shift key (instead of opening the file in an editor).

showDropSelector.title: Show Drop Selector
showDropSelector.description: Controls if a widget is shown when dropping files into the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is dropped.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never show the drop selector widget. Instead the default drop provider is always used.

oneOf.title: After Drop
oneOf.description: Show the drop selector widget after a file is dropped into the editor.

emptySelectionClipboard.title: Empty Selection Clipboard
emptySelectionClipboard.description: Controls whether copying without a selection copies the current line.

folding.title: Folding
folding.description: Controls whether the editor has code folding enabled.

foldingHighlight.title: Folding Highlight
foldingHighlight.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight folded ranges.

foldingMaximumRegions.title: Folding Maximum Regions
foldingMaximumRegions.description: The maximum number of foldable regions. Increasing this value may result in the editor becoming less responsive when the current source has a large number of foldable regions.

foldingStrategy.title: Folding Strategy
foldingStrategy.description: Controls the strategy for computing folding ranges.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Use a language-specific folding strategy if available, else the indentation-based one.

oneOf.title: Indentation
oneOf.description: Use the indentation-based folding strategy.

glyphMargin.title: Glyph Margin
glyphMargin.description: Controls whether the editor should render the vertical glyph margin. Glyph margin is mostly used for debugging.

alternativeDeclarationCommand.title: Alternative Declaration Command
alternativeDeclarationCommand.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Declaration' is the current location.

alternativeDefinitionCommand.title: Alternative Definition Command
alternativeDefinitionCommand.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Definition' is the current location.

alternativeImplementationCommand.title: Alternative Implementation Command
alternativeImplementationCommand.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Implementation' is the current location.

alternativeReferenceCommand.title: Alternative Reference Command
alternativeReferenceCommand.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Reference' is the current location.

alternativeTypeDefinitionCommand.title: Alternative Type Definition Command
alternativeTypeDefinitionCommand.description: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Type Definition' is the current location.

multipleDeclarations.title: Multiple Declarations
multipleDeclarations.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Declaration'-command when multiple target locations exist.

multipleDefinitions.title: Multiple Definitions
multipleDefinitions.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist.

multipleImplementations.title: Multiple Implementations
multipleImplementations.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Implementations'-command when multiple target locations exist.

multipleReferences.title: Multiple References
multipleReferences.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to References'-command when multiple target locations exist.

multipleTypeDefinitions.title: Multiple Type Definitions
multipleTypeDefinitions.description: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Type Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist.

bracketPairs.title: Bracket Pairs
bracketPairs.description: Controls whether bracket pair guides are enabled or not.

oneOf.title: True
oneOf.description: Enables bracket pair guides.

oneOf.title: False
oneOf.description: Disables bracket pair guides.

oneOf.title: Active
oneOf.description: Enables bracket pair guides only for the active bracket pair.

bracketPairsHorizontal.title: Bracket Pairs Horizontal
bracketPairsHorizontal.description: Controls whether horizontal bracket pair guides are enabled or not.

oneOf.title: True
oneOf.description: Enables horizontal guides as addition to vertical bracket pair guides.

oneOf.title: False
oneOf.description: Disables horizontal bracket pair guides.

oneOf.title: Active
oneOf.description: Enables horizontal guides only for the active bracket pair.

highlightActiveBracketPair.title: Highlight Active Bracket Pair
highlightActiveBracketPair.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active bracket pair.

highlightActiveIndentation.title: Highlight Active Indentation
highlightActiveIndentation.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active indent guide.

oneOf.title: True
oneOf.description: Highlights the active indent guide.

oneOf.title: False
oneOf.description: Do not highlight the active indent guide.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Highlights the active indent guide even if bracket guides are highlighted.

indentation.title: Indentation
indentation.description: Controls whether the editor should render indent guides.

hideCursorInOverviewRuler.title: Hide Cursor In Overview Ruler
hideCursorInOverviewRuler.description: Controls whether the cursor should be hidden in the overview ruler.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether the hover is shown.

above.title: Above
above.description: Prefer showing hovers above the line, if there's space.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown.

hidingDelay.title: Hiding Delay
hidingDelay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is hidden. Requires `#hover/sticky#` to be enabled.

sticky.title: Sticky
sticky.description: Controls whether the hover should remain visible when mouse is moved over it.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables the inlay hints in the editor.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Inlay hints are disabled

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Inlay hints are enabled

oneOf.title: Off Unless Pressed
oneOf.description: Inlay hints are hidden by default and show when holding `Ctrl+Option` or `Ctrl+Alt`

oneOf.title: On Unless Pressed
oneOf.description: Inlay hints are showing by default and hide when holding `Ctrl+Option` or `Ctrl+Alt`

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: Controls font family of inlay hints in the editor. When set to empty, the `#fontFamily#` is used.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.description: Controls font size of inlay hints in the editor. As default the `#fontSize#` is used when the configured value is less than 5 or greater than the editor font size.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Enables the padding around the inlay hints in the editor.

inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose.title: Inline Completions Accessibility Verbose
inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose.description: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.

insertSpaces.title: Insert Spaces
insertSpaces.description: Insert spaces when pressing `Tab`. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `#detectIndentation#` is on.

largeFileOptimizations.title: Large File Optimizations
largeFileOptimizations.description: Special handling for large files to disable certain memory intensive features.

letterSpacing.title: Letter Spacing
letterSpacing.description: Controls the letter spacing in pixels.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables the Code Action lightbulb in the editor.

lineHeight.title: Line Height
lineHeight.description: Controls the line height. Use 0 to automatically compute the line height from the font size. Values between 0 and 8 will be used as a multiplier with the font size. Values greater than or equal to 8 will be used as effective values.

lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers
lineNumbers.description: Controls the display of line numbers.

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Line numbers are rendered as absolute number.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Line numbers are not rendered.

oneOf.title: Relative
oneOf.description: Line numbers are rendered as distance in lines to cursor position.

oneOf.title: Interval
oneOf.description: Line numbers are rendered every 10 lines.

linkedEditing.title: Linked Editing
linkedEditing.description: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are updated while editing.

links.title: Links
links.description: Control whether the editor should detect links and make them clickable.

maxTokenizationLineLength.title: Max Tokenization Line Length
maxTokenizationLineLength.description: Lines above this length will not be tokenized for performance reasons.

mouseWheelScrollSensitivity.title: Mouse Wheel Scroll Sensitivity
mouseWheelScrollSensitivity.description: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

mouseWheelZoom.title: Mouse Wheel Zoom
mouseWheelZoom.description: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Ctrl`.

multiCursorLimit.title: Multi Cursor Limit
multiCursorLimit.description: Controls the max number of cursors that can be in an active editor at once.

multiCursorMergeOverlapping.title: Multi Cursor Merge Overlapping
multiCursorMergeOverlapping.description: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.

multiCursorModifier.title: Multi Cursor Modifier
multiCursorModifier.description: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. The Go to Definition and Open Link mouse gestures will adapt such that they do not conflict with the `#multicursorModifier#`.

oneOf.title: Control / Command
oneOf.description: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS.

oneOf.title: Alt / Option
oneOf.description: Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.

multiCursorPaste.title: Multi Cursor Paste
multiCursorPaste.description: Controls pasting when the line count of the pasted text matches the cursor count.

oneOf.title: Spread
oneOf.description: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text.

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: Each cursor pastes the full text.

occurrencesHighlight.title: Occurrences Highlight
occurrencesHighlight.description: Controls whether occurrences should be highlighted across open files.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Does not highlight occurrences.

oneOf.title: Single File
oneOf.description: Highlights occurrences only in the current file.

oneOf.title: Multi File
oneOf.description: Highlights occurrences across all valid open files.

overviewRulerBorder.title: Overview Ruler Border
overviewRulerBorder.description: Controls whether a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.

bottom.title: Bottom
bottom.description: Controls the amount of space between the bottom edge of the editor and the last line.

top.title: Top
top.description: Controls the amount of space between the top edge of the editor and the first line.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enables a pop-up that shows parameter documentation and type information as you type.

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.description: Controls whether the parameter hints menu cycles or closes when reaching the end of the list.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether you can paste content in different ways.

showPasteSelector.title: Show Paste Selector
showPasteSelector.description: Controls if a widget is shown when pasting content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is pasted.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never show the paste selector widget. Instead the default pasting behavior is always used.

oneOf.title: After Paste
oneOf.description: Show the paste selector widget after content is pasted into the editor.

peekWidgetDefaultFocus.title: Peek Widget Default Focus
peekWidgetDefaultFocus.description: Controls whether to focus the inline editor or the tree in the peek widget.

oneOf.title: Tree
oneOf.description: Focus the tree when opening peek

oneOf.title: Editor
oneOf.description: Focus the editor when opening peek

renderControlCharacters.title: Render Control Characters
renderControlCharacters.description: Controls whether the editor should render control characters.

renderFinalNewline.title: Render Final Newline
renderFinalNewline.description: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline.

renderLineHighlight.title: Render Line Highlight
renderLineHighlight.description: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight.

oneOf.title: All
oneOf.description: Highlights both the gutter and the current line.

renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus.title: Render Line Highlight Only When Focus
renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus.description: Controls if the editor should render the current line highlight only when the editor is focused.

renderWhitespace.title: Render Whitespace
renderWhitespace.description: Controls how the editor should render whitespace characters.

oneOf.title: Boundary
oneOf.description: Render whitespace characters except for single spaces between words.

oneOf.title: Selection
oneOf.description: Render whitespace characters only on selected text.

oneOf.title: Trailing
oneOf.description: Render only trailing whitespace characters.

roundedSelection.title: Rounded Selection
roundedSelection.description: Controls whether selections should have rounded corners.

rulers.title: Rulers
rulers.description: Render vertical rulers after a certain number of monospace characters. Use multiple values for multiple rulers. No rulers are drawn if array is empty.

horizontal.title: Horizontal
horizontal.description: Controls the visibility of the horizontal scrollbar.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.

oneOf.title: Visible
oneOf.description: The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible.

oneOf.title: Hidden
oneOf.description: The horizontal scrollbar will always be hidden.

horizontalScrollbarSize.title: Horizontal Scrollbar Size
horizontalScrollbarSize.description: The height of the horizontal scrollbar.

ignoreHorizontalScrollbarInContentHeight.title: Ignore Horizontal Scrollbar In Content Height
ignoreHorizontalScrollbarInContentHeight.description: When set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase the size of the editor's content.

scrollByPage.title: Scroll By Page
scrollByPage.description: Controls whether clicks scroll by page or jump to click position.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: Controls the visibility of the vertical scrollbar.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: The vertical scrollbar will be visible only when necessary.

oneOf.title: Visible
oneOf.description: The vertical scrollbar will always be visible.

oneOf.title: Hidden
oneOf.description: The vertical scrollbar will always be hidden.

verticalScrollbarSize.title: Vertical Scrollbar Size
verticalScrollbarSize.description: The width of the vertical scrollbar.

scrollBeyondLastColumn.title: Scroll Beyond Last Column
scrollBeyondLastColumn.description: Controls the number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.

scrollBeyondLastLine.title: Scroll Beyond Last Line
scrollBeyondLastLine.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line.

scrollPredominantAxis.title: Scroll Predominant Axis
scrollPredominantAxis.description: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically and horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.

selectionHighlight.title: Selection Highlight
selectionHighlight.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether the semantic highlighting is shown for the languages that support it.

oneOf.title: True
oneOf.description: Semantic highlighting enabled for all color themes.

oneOf.title: False
oneOf.description: Semantic highlighting disabled for all color themes.

oneOf.title: Configured By Theme
oneOf.description: Semantic highlighting is configured by the current theme's `semanticHighlighting` setting.

showFoldingControls.title: Show Folding Controls
showFoldingControls.description: Controls when the folding controls on the gutter are shown.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Always show the folding controls.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size.

oneOf.title: Mouse over
oneOf.description: Only show the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.

showUnused.title: Show Unused
showUnused.description: Controls fading out of unused code.

selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace.title: Select Leading And Trailing Whitespace
selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace.description: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should always be selected.

selectSubwords.title: Select Subwords
selectSubwords.description: Whether subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' or 'foo_bar') should be selected.

smoothScrolling.title: Smooth Scrolling
smoothScrolling.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll using an animation.

stablePeek.title: Stable Peek
stablePeek.description: Keep peek editors open even when double-clicking their content or when hitting `Escape`.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Shows the nested current scopes during the scroll at the top of the editor.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: Defines the model to use for determining which lines to stick. If the outline model does not exist, it will fall back on the folding provider model which falls back on the indentation model. This order is respected in all three cases.

maxLineCount.title: Max Line Count
maxLineCount.description: Defines the maximum number of sticky lines to show.

scrollWithEditor.title: Scroll With Editor
scrollWithEditor.description: Enable scrolling of Sticky Scroll with the editor's horizontal scrollbar.

stickyTabStops.title: Sticky Tab Stops
stickyTabStops.description: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Disable tab completions.

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Tab complete will insert the best matching suggestion when pressing tab.

oneOf.title: Only Snippets
oneOf.description: Tab complete snippets when their prefix match. Works best when 'quickSuggestions' aren't enabled.

tabFocusMode.title: Tab Focus Mode
tabFocusMode.description: Controls whether the editor receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.

tabSize.title: Tab Size
tabSize.description: The number of spaces a tab is equal to. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `#detectIntentation#` is on.

unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine.title: Unfold On Click After End Of Line
unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine.description: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line.

allowedCharacters.title: Allowed Characters
allowedCharacters.description: Defines allowed characters that are not being highlighted.

allowedLocales.title: Allowed Locales
allowedLocales.description: Unicode characters that are common in allowed locales are not being highlighted.

ambiguousCharacters.title: Ambiguous Characters
ambiguousCharacters.description: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in current user locale.

includeComments.title: Include Comments
includeComments.description: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

includeStrings.title: Include Strings
includeStrings.description: Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

invisibleCharacters.title: Invisible Characters
invisibleCharacters.description: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.

nonBasicASCII.title: Non Basic ASCII
nonBasicASCII.description: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.

unusualLineTerminators.title: Unusual Line Terminators
unusualLineTerminators.description: Remove unusual line terminators that might cause problems.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Unusual line terminators are ignored.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Unusual line terminators are automatically removed.

oneOf.title: Prompt
oneOf.description: Unusual line terminators prompt to be removed.

useTabStops.title: Use Tab Stops
useTabStops.description: Inserting and deleting whitespace follows tab stops.

wordBreak.title: Word Break
wordBreak.description: Controls the word break rules used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text.

oneOf.title: Normal
oneOf.description: Use the default line break rule.

oneOf.title: Keep All
oneOf.description: Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.

wordSeparators.title: Word Separators
wordSeparators.description: Characters that will be used as word separators when doing word related navigations or operations.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Lines will never wrap.

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Lines will wrap at the viewport width.

oneOf.title: Word Wrap Column
oneOf.description: Lines will wrap at `#wordWrapColumn#`.

oneOf.title: Bounded
oneOf.description: Lines will wrap at the minimum of viewport and `#wordWrapColumn#`.

wordWrapColumn.title: Word Wrap Column
wordWrapColumn.description: Controls the wrapping column of the editor when `#wordWrap#` is `wordWrapColumn` or `bounded`.

wrappingIndent.title: Wrapping Indent
wrappingIndent.description: Controls the indentation of wrapped lines.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: No indentation. Wrapped lines begin at column 1.

oneOf.title: Same
oneOf.description: Wrapped lines get the same indentation as the parent.

oneOf.title: Indent
oneOf.description: Wrapped lines get +1 indentation toward the parent.

oneOf.title: Deep Indent
oneOf.description: Wrapped lines get +2 indentation toward the parent.

wrappingStrategy.title: Wrapping Strategy
wrappingStrategy.description: Controls the algorithm that computes wrapping points. Note that when in accessibility mode, advanced will be used for the best experience.

oneOf.title: Simple
oneOf.description: Assumes that all characters are of the same width. This is a fast algorithm that works correctly for monospace fonts and certain scripts (like Latin characters) where glyphs are of equal width.

oneOf.title: Advanced
oneOf.description: Delegates wrapping points computation to the browser. This is a slow algorithm, that might cause freezes for large files, but it works correctly in all cases.

cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.title: Cursor Smooth Caret Animation
cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.description: Controls whether the smooth caret animation should be enabled.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Smooth caret animation is disabled.

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Smooth caret animation is always enabled.

oneOf.title: Explicit
oneOf.description: Smooth caret animation is enabled only when the user moves the cursor with an explicit gesture.

cursorSurroundingLines.title: Cursor Surrounding Lines
cursorSurroundingLines.description: Controls the minimal number of visible leading lines (minimum 0) and trailing lines (minimum 1) surrounding the cursor. Known as 'scrollOff' or 'scrollOffset' in some other editors.

oneOf.title: Default
oneOf.description: `#cursorSurroundingLines#` is enforced only when triggered via the keyboard or API.

oneOf.title: All
oneOf.description: `#cursorSurroundingLines#` is enforced always.

cursorWidth.title: Cursor Width
cursorWidth.description: Controls the width of the cursor when `#cursorStyle#` is set to `line`.

addExtraSpaceOnTop.title: Add Extra Space On Top
addExtraSpaceOnTop.description: Controls whether the Find Widget should add extra lines on top of the editor. When true, you can scroll beyond the first line when the Find Widget is visible.

autoFindInSelection.title: Auto Find In Selection
autoFindInSelection.description: Controls the condition for turning on Find in Selection automatically.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Always turn on Find in Selection automatically.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never turn on Find in Selection automatically.

oneOf.title: Multiline
oneOf.description: Turn on Find in Selection automatically when multiple lines of content are selected.

cursorMoveOnType.title: Cursor Move On Type
cursorMoveOnType.description: Controls whether the cursor should jump to find matches while typing.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Controls whether the search automatically restarts from the beginning (or the end) when no further matches can be found.

seedSearchStringFromSelection.title: Seed Search String From Selection
seedSearchStringFromSelection.description: Controls whether the search string in the Find Widget is seeded from the editor selection.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Always seed search string from the editor selection, including word at cursor position.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never seed search string from the editor selection.

oneOf.title: Selection
oneOf.description: Only seed search string from the editor selection.

fontLigatures.title: Font Ligatures
fontLigatures.description: Configures font ligatures or font features.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels.

formatOnPaste.title: Format On Paste
formatOnPaste.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the pasted content. A formatter must be available and the formatter should be able to format a range in a document.

formatOnType.title: Format On Type
formatOnType.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Controls whether the editor shows Code Lens.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows unchanged regions.

contextLineCount.title: Context Line Count
contextLineCount.description: Controls how many lines are used as context when comparing unchanged regions.

minimumLineCount.title: Minimum Line Count
minimumLineCount.description: Controls how many lines are used as a minimum for unchanged regions.

revealLineCount.title: Reveal Line Count
revealLineCount.description: Controls how many lines are used for unchanged regions.

ignoreTrimWhitespace.title: Ignore Trim Whitespace
ignoreTrimWhitespace.description: When enabled, the diff editor ignores changes in leading or trailing whitespace.

maxComputationTime.title: Max Computation Time
maxComputationTime.description: Timeout in milliseconds after which diff computation is cancelled. Use 0 for no timeout.

maxFileSize.title: Max File Size
maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in MB for which to compute diffs. Use 0 for no limit.

renderIndicators.title: Render Indicators
renderIndicators.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows +/- indicators for added/removed changes.

renderMarginRevertIcon.title: Render Margin Revert Icon
renderMarginRevertIcon.description: When enabled, the diff editor shows arrows in its glyph margin to revert changes.

renderSideBySide.title: Render Side By Side
renderSideBySide.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows the diff side by side or inline.

renderSideBySideInlineBreakpoint.title: Render Side By Side Inline Breakpoint
renderSideBySideInlineBreakpoint.description: If the diff editor width is smaller than this value, the inline view is used.

useInlineViewWhenSpaceIsLimited.title: Use Inline View When Space Is Limited
useInlineViewWhenSpaceIsLimited.description: If enabled and the editor width is too small, the inline view is used.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether the minimap is shown.

autohide.title: Autohide
autohide.description: Controls whether the minimap is hidden automatically.

maxColumn.title: Max Column
maxColumn.description: Limit the width of the minimap to render at most a certain number of columns.

renderCharacters.title: Render Characters
renderCharacters.description: Render the actual characters on a line as opposed to color blocks.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scale of content drawn in the minimap: 1, 2 or 3.

showSlider.title: Show Slider
showSlider.description: Controls when the minimap slider is shown.

side.title: Side
side.description: Controls the side where to render the minimap.

size.title: Size
size.description: Controls the size of the minimap.

oneOf.title: Proportional
oneOf.description: The minimap has the same size as the editor contents (and might scroll).

oneOf.title: Fill
oneOf.description: The minimap will stretch or shrink as necessary to fill the height of the editor (no scrolling).

oneOf.title: Fit
oneOf.description: The minimap will shrink as necessary to never be larger than the editor (no scrolling).

acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter.title: Accept Suggestion On Commit Character
acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter.description: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on commit characters. For example, in Structured Text, the semi-colon (`;`) can be a commit character that accepts a suggestion and types that character.

acceptSuggestionOnEnter.title: Accept Suggestion On Enter
acceptSuggestionOnEnter.description: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on `Enter`, in addition to `Tab`. Helps to avoid ambiguity between inserting new lines or accepting suggestions.

oneOf.title: Smart
oneOf.description: Only accept a suggestion with `Enter` when it makes a textual change.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Controls whether to automatically show inline suggestions in the editor.

fontFamily.title: Font Family
fontFamily.description: Controls the font family of the inline suggestions.

showToolbar.title: Show Toolbar
showToolbar.description: Controls when to show the inline suggestion toolbar.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Show the inline suggestion toolbar whenever an inline suggestion is shown.

oneOf.title: On Hover
oneOf.description: Show the inline suggestion toolbar when hovering over an inline suggestion.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never show the inline suggestion toolbar.

suppressSuggestions.title: Suppress Suggestions
suppressSuggestions.description: Controls how inline suggestions interact with the suggest widget. If enabled, the suggest widget is not shown automatically when inline suggestions are available.

quickSuggestions.title: Quick Suggestions
quickSuggestions.description: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up while typing. This can be controlled for typing in comments, strings, and other code. Quick suggestion can be configured to show as ghost text or with the suggest widget. Also be aware of the `#suggestOnTriggerCharacters#`-setting which controls if suggestions are triggered by special characters.

quickSuggestionsDelay.title: Quick Suggestions Delay
quickSuggestionsDelay.description: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will show up.

screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion.title: Screen Reader Announce Inline Suggestion
screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion.description: Control whether inline suggestions are announced by a screen reader.

snippetSuggestions.title: Snippet Suggestions
snippetSuggestions.description: Controls whether snippets are shown with other suggestions and how they are sorted.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: Show snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: Show snippet suggestions below other suggestions.

oneOf.title: Inline
oneOf.description: Show snippet suggestions with other suggestions.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Do not show snippet suggestions.

filterGraceful.title: Filter Graceful
filterGraceful.description: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.

insertMode.title: Insert Mode
insertMode.description: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on extensions opting into this feature.

oneOf.title: Insert
oneOf.description: Insert suggestion without overwriting text right of the cursor.

oneOf.title: Replace
oneOf.description: Insert suggestion and overwrite text right of the cursor.

localityBonus.title: Locality Bonus
localityBonus.description: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.

matchOnWordStartOnly.title: Match On Word Start Only
matchOnWordStartOnly.description: When enabled IntelliSense filtering requires that the first character matches on a word start. For example, `c` on `Console` or `WebContext` but _not_ on `description`. When disabled IntelliSense will show more results but still sorts them by match quality.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Controls whether to preview the suggestion outcome in the editor.

selectionMode.title: Selection Mode
selectionMode.description: Controls whether a suggestion is selected when the widget shows. Note that this only applies to automatically triggered suggestions (`#quickSuggestions#` and `#suggestOnTriggerCharacters#`) and that a suggestion is always selected when explicitly invoked, e.g via `Ctrl+Space`.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Always select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Never select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense.

oneOf.title: When Trigger Character
oneOf.description: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense from a trigger character.

oneOf.title: When Quick Suggestion
oneOf.description: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.

shareSuggestSelections.title: Share Suggest Selections
shareSuggestSelections.description: Controls whether remembered suggestion selections are shared between multiple workspaces and windows (needs `#suggestSelection#`).

showIcons.title: Show Icons
showIcons.description: Controls whether to show or hide icons in suggestions.

showInlineDetails.title: Show Inline Details
showInlineDetails.description: Controls whether suggest details show inline with the label or only in the details widget.

showStatusBar.title: Show Status Bar
showStatusBar.description: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the suggest widget.

snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions.title: Snippets Prevent Quick Suggestions
snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions.description: Controls whether an active snippet prevents quick suggestions.

suggestFontSize.title: Suggest Font Size
suggestFontSize.description: Font size for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `#fontSize#` is used.

suggestLineHeight.title: Suggest Line Height
suggestLineHeight.description: Line height for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `#lineHeight#` is used.

suggestOnTriggerCharacters.title: Suggest On Trigger Characters
suggestOnTriggerCharacters.description: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up when typing trigger characters.

suggestSelection.title: Suggest Selection
suggestSelection.description: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list.

oneOf.title: First
oneOf.description: Always select the first suggestion.

oneOf.title: Recently Used
oneOf.description: Select recent suggestions unless further typing selects one, e.g. `console.| -> console.log` because `log` has been completed recently.

oneOf.title: Recently Used By Prefix
oneOf.description: Select suggestions based on previous prefixes that have completed those suggestions, e.g. `co -> console` and `con -> const`.

wordBasedSuggestions.title: Word Based Suggestions
wordBasedSuggestions.description: Controls whether completions should be computed based on words in the document and from which documents they are computed.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Turn off Word Based Suggestions.

oneOf.title: Current Document
oneOf.description: Only suggest words from the active document.

oneOf.title: Matching Documents
oneOf.description: Suggest words from all open documents of the same language.

oneOf.title: All Documents
oneOf.description: Suggest words from all open documents.

oneOf.title: Peek
oneOf.description: Show Peek view of the results

oneOf.title: Goto and Peek
oneOf.description: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view

oneOf.title: Goto
oneOf.description: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Quick suggestions show inside the suggest widget

oneOf.title: Inline
oneOf.description: Quick suggestions show as ghost text

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: Quick suggestions are disabled
